title: The Butter Curl on the Cool Plate
youtube_title: The Butter Curl on the Cool Plate | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Ximena wants to check on a butter curl meant to soften on its own before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Ximena leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
